sections.section_title: SBS compensation cell for I/Os software code register (SBS_CCSWCR)
sections.text_helper: Section 12.5.9 "SBS compensation cell for I/Os software code register (SBS_CCSWCR)" in chapter 12 (System configuration, boot, and security (SBS)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 367.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x118
Reset value: 0x0000 0078
Reset: system reset
Register security: always accessible
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:4 SW_APSRC1[3:0]: PMOS compensation code for the VDD power rails
This bitfield is written by software to define an I/O compensation cell code for PMOS
transistors of the VDDIO power rail. This code is applied to the I/O when CS1 is set in
SBS_CCSR.
Bits 3:0 SW_ANSRC1[3:0]: NMOS compensation code for VDD power rails
This bitfield is written by software to define an I/O compensation cell code for NMOS
transistors of the VDD power rail. This code is applied to the I/O when CS1 is set
inSBS_CCSR.
